description: Source discovery queue for international case imports. Listing a collection does not authorise copying, publishing or mapping individual incidents.

sources.name: GEP UFO/UAP case data 1972–September 2026
sources.note: 2.5 MB CSV. Exact licence of October 2026 version and column contents must be checked before republishing. Do not import source text or raw location fields until privacy validation; map only reviewed city-level coordinates. Source dataset is not independently verified sightings.

sources.name: CNES GEIPAN case search
sources.note: Preserve A/B/C/D classification and changes; individual source and approximate town location required.

sources.name: Arquivo Nacional OVNI collection
sources.note: Brazil's National Archives documented 743 mixed archival records in 2018 (1952–2016), not 743 unique sightings. Official SIAN requires access and may have newer records; obtain stable individual ARX catalogue identifiers and verify re-use rights before importing. No coordinates or witness narratives.

sources.name: Russian historical UAP case-source discovery
sources.note: No verified bulk source approved. Seek primary documents and translation before importing.

sources.name: Indian historical UAP case-source discovery
sources.note: No verified bulk source approved. Seek official aviation/defence documentation or attributable contemporary reporting.

sources.name: South African historical UAP case-source discovery
sources.note: Do not copy third-party sighting databases without permission; review original reports and city-level locations.

sources.name: Additional African country archives
sources.note: Country-by-country source review; distinguish reports from independently investigated incidents.

sources.name: DGAC SEFAA official resolved cases by year
sources.note: Official SEFAA publishes resolved-case year links (2018–2026). Identify stable individual case identifiers, distinguish resolved explanations from unidentified reports, check reuse conditions; do not import case texts or precise locations without review.
